gen-dafont-visitor-gf-pridi: Nostalgic pixel-era Visitor bends its strokes like cable, no swelling anywhere. Pridi, a classic serif, leaves generous gaps between curve ends and stems, so give it a little extra size.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-scope-one: Retro and blocky, with gaping e mouths. Scope One counters spill into the space around them, and that open, stubby-limbed serif is the pair's strongest quality against Visitor's round, uniform bowls.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px reads bookish and dignified, a text serif with spacious a, e and s. Under Visitor's blunt, solder-smooth joins, a long stretch of it would feel unhurried and easy on the eye.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified Suwannaphum would look odd if shrunk to a whisper? Actually, it holds a high, squared-off x-height. Visitor, if made small, would lose its neon-tube thickness, while that text serif handles large sizes without trouble.
gen-dafont-visitor-inter: Chunky digital charm up top, with gaping e mouths. Inter, a sans with hollow-reed counters and a smooth tube-like line, can run slightly smaller.
gen-dafont-visitor-mulish: Nostalgic and a bit digital up top. Mulish drops all thick-and-thin variation and opens its apertures like a horseshoe magnet, so beside Visitor's solder-thin strokes the page feels friendly, modern and uncluttered.
gen-dafont-visitor-rubik: Soft, clean Rubik has lowercase that looks big beside its capitals. Its open round letters stay clear at small sizes, so the body can shrink while Visitor's even terminals stay put.
gen-dafont-woodgod-bitter: Dependable Bitter, a slab-serif, brings a very large lowercase eye and a see-through gap in each s, which sits against Woodgod's commanding, vintage channels into every bowl. A longer read stays grounded.
gen-dafont-woodgod-fs-bespoke-sans: Woodgod stands tall, its lowercase nearly reaching the capitals. Bespoke Sans sits a notch lower and sharper, with generous room where curves meet stems, giving the page a clear step down in height.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-epunda-slab: Woodgod's wide channel into every bowl gives it a commanding, vintage look. Epunda Slab, a text serif, answers with tall rounded lowercase and a visibly gaping c, so the page keeps a dignified, classic tone.
